Based on 10 reviews

Review Supercut?

Reviewers describe Supercut as a simple, polished screen recorder that makes recording, sharing, and follow-up work feel unusually easy. They repeatedly praise its speed, clean design, low system impact, and AI help with titles, descriptions, and turning recordings into concise reports. Several compare it favorably with Loom, and one says it stands out in a crowded category through attention to detail and ease of use. The main critique is narrow: one reviewer wants Screen Studio-style zoom effects for typing and cursor movement.
